feature_contract.goal: Preserve the whole original gameplay HUD native sprite family including exact 6th/6 and timer text when original priority chains are rebuilt or recycled, without leaking a previous producer's eye owner onto foreign nodes.
feature_contract.scope_boundary: Require real terminal native priority-tail proof for known exact native HUD SpriteNodes only, retaining earlier source-root identity, registration epochs and unchanged R84 per-eye rendering plus original fallback. Do not modify the stage timer, shader WVP, menu cropping, FFB, SkyGlow, R26_SAFE or other lanes.
trace_stages: Original game animated 6th/6 and clip-digit gameplay HUD producers append into native priority root, with root and previous tail captured at exact E8 entry.
Post-call TagAppendedNodes and TagDirectVrSpriteNodes use the same bounded FirstVerifiedAppendedNodeOnStableRoot gate before registering an exact node and retaining newer nested producer serial.
R84 R30 fixed-function FVF142, XYZRHW and shader HUD draws consume the valid node producer and attempt both-eye D3D9 submissions ahead of x64 OpenXR host presentation.
subcomponents: Reject absent prior tail snapshots rather than interpreting null as proof of an empty native priority: only the actual root sentinel can mean first-in-priority.
Require the current recorded tail to terminate the live bounded list so linked interior nodes, reclaimed tails and cyclic sprite queues never inherit a stale HUD/GOAL/+TIME eye owner.
Keep positive native first-entry and two-sibling queue ownership plus negative stale, re-linked, cycle, interior-tail and iteration-bound compile-time tests.

acceptance_items.behavior_area: Original rank and timer native gameplay HUD producer through stable SpriteNode root to R84 stereo draw
acceptance_items.expected_behavior: A genuine terminal tail and unchanged live root preserve all newly added siblings and their exact screen HUD ownership without changing game animation.

acceptance_items.behavior_area: Stale or malformed native priority queues, unknown producer and protected fallback
acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Null old tail, recycled nonterminal new tail, cyclic list and bounded reachability failure cannot relabel a foreign native sprite; fallback remains original drawing.

acceptance_items.behavior_area: Exact-SHA Win32 R84 native DX9Ex game and R26_SAFE, x64 OpenXR host, package, Domain and impacted source inspectors
acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Required GitHub Actions Gate succeeds on the same validation-bearing commit before BUILD_VERIFIED; independent Quest3 optical behavior stays UNTESTED.

diagnosis.original_evidence: Original OutRun native HUD rank/timer/GOAL SpriteNode producer writes use priority-root sentinel tails; an absent captured tail is not an actual empty root and a recycled tail pointer can remain reachable inside a cyclic or extended list.
source_trace: The before-source native snapshot records sprite_prio_root[prio] and root->tail_4 in existing hooks_textures.cpp and hooks_uiscaling.cpp.
The source queue proof previously admitted null oldTail as the empty list and returned a recorded newTail without checking that newTail->next_0 was terminal.
The common helper is the gate for exact native ScreenHud sprite registration that feeds existing R84 R30 fixed-function FVF142 and GPU per-eye submissions.
alternatives_rejected: Do not globally classify unknown sprites as ScreenHud, force D3DX Flush, weaken source producer token checks, change world or SkyGlow eye mapping, or assert observed HMD errors from static proof.
diagnosis.root_cause: The previous source append proof could accept a malformed null previous tail and an interior recorded newTail on a live root, granting invalid prior HUD source identity on a reused or cyclic queue.
diagnosis.fix_evidence: Material implementation SHA a2796ce42b9a1622d8b799c03b0dce3dd8f48b95 changes the actual shared C++ SpriteNode tail reachability helper to require a non-null old tail and terminal live new tail.
diagnosis.negative_test_evidence: TerminalTailQueueOwnershipGuards constexpr regression checks correct first-in-priority and multi-sibling tags, null before-tail, interior reused tail, cyclic new tail, detached tail and bounded traversal.
diagnosis.eye_ownership: Only exact producer tags from a real terminal native queue tail reach the existing R84 HUD left/right Draw path; unknown source stays on unchanged native D3D9 fallback. Quest3 not exercised.

notes: One-source C++ strict native queue terminal ownership change plus constexpr positive/negative regressions. First exact SHA's DX9Ex Active policy gate rejected the absent 01047 feature record before game/host builds; this commit supplies the honest run contract without changing the original material SHA. No HMD acceptance or performance measurement and no score increment until independently confirmed user-visible outcome.
